gap_impact.note: The committed artefact cohort was recomputed at run time; the fixed-cohort panel uses the committed artefact keys. The swapped 5+5 keys change the panel directly and also shift per-origin active-entity/track sets, so the metric deltas below are the measured net effect, not only the rows on the swapped keys.

decision_inputs.pre_registered_rule: H2.2: signal is SUPPORTED if the cluster CI on delta-AP excludes zero in the majority of pre-declared windows AND pooled CIs exclude zero under BOTH clustering choices; it is a WELL-POWERED NEGATIVE if the pooled point estimate is inside the MDE but no CI excludes zero; otherwise still underpowered.

limitations: AP is not a binomial proportion; Var(AP) ~= m(1-m)/n_positives is a plug-in approximation, not an exact variance. With m = 0.5 it is a conservative upper bound on m(1-m).
Real skill usually makes the bootstrap SE larger than the no-skill simulation (reported separately as the optimistic lower bound), which is why the analytic bound defaults to the m = 0.5 worst case.
The paired correlation is assumed (default 0); positively correlated scorers have a smaller SE.
The authoritative MDE uses mde_from_se(clustered_bootstrap_delta_ap(...)['se_delta']) on the actual holdout, not this design value.
